shortBio.en: Van Halen guitarist; tapping, harmonics, and brown-sound midrange as 1978 guitar-hero standard.
shortBio.zh: Van Halen 吉他手；tapping、泛音与棕色中频成为 1978 吉他英雄标准。

body.en:
Born 1955. Frankenstein Strat-style build, MXR Phase 90/Flanger, Marshall midrange. Eruption (1978) is the technique citation; Ain't Talkin' 'Bout Love and Hot for Teacher lock riff + solo grammar.

Constant across Roth and Hagar eras: high-gain precision and keyboard pop on 1984.
body.zh:
1955 年生。Frankenstein 式 Strat 改制、MXR Phase 90/Flanger、Marshall 中频。Eruption（1978）是技术引用；Ain't Talkin' 'Bout Love 与 Hot for Teacher 锁死 riff+独奏语法。

跨 Roth/Hagar 时期的常量：高增益精度，以及 1984 上的键盘流行写法。
